name: happy_path
description: Ice maker fault: basics walkthrough, photo of the outlet, a dangerous second photo (scissors at the cable) the agent must warn about, engineer booking, polite goodbye.

events.transcript: Hi, Alex. I'm having trouble on my ice maker.
I think it might be better if I give you a photo and you can check.
Can you see if the power is on for the ice maker?
The other one next to it works, but maybe you should look at the switches in the photo and see if one is on and one is off.
I believe so. Let me show you another thing I'm trying, and you can tell me if it's a good idea.
Yes. I would. But can you book a human engineer for me?
This Monday at 02:00. Works, and, yes, that's the issue.
No. That's fine. Thank you very much.
